promptVersions.body:
Settings are grouped into sections on the left. To jump to one, type a word in the search box.

Everyone can read these settings. Changing them needs the BarnCRM Admin role.

Just installed BarnCRM? Start with the Setup Assistant on the Home tab. The What's new card on the same tab lists what changed after each upgrade.
promptVersions.description: First visit to BarnCRM Settings: how to get around, and where the Setup Assistant and What's new are.
promptVersions.title: Getting around BarnCRM Settings
